subject.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled

question: Should Feishu source-message recall be a default cancellation signal for every source-bound active and broadcast agent dispatch, with no attempt to roll back side effects already issued before the abort arrives?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded to the Feishu plugin, but it defines user-visible cancellation semantics and applies them to multiple dispatch modes; tests cannot decide whether that permanent behavior is the intended product policy.

options.title: Approve Feishu recall cancellation
options.body: Accept recall as withdrawal of the source turn’s authorization, require current-head live proof, and land the bounded Feishu implementation.

options.title: Limit the first rollout
options.body: Retain reply suppression and queued-ingress dropping but narrow or defer active/broadcast abort behavior until the cross-channel cancellation policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve Feishu recall cancellation
recommendation.body: Accept recall as withdrawal of the source turn’s authorization, require current-head live proof, and land the bounded Feishu implementation.
